items.description: Implement classic Snake rules, timing, inputs, paper presentation and audio mapping; preserve existing games.
items.verify: Runner requires nonempty Snake engine/UI groups and runs the full existing suite; report skips and fail discovery errors. Include all brief edge cases and cleanup tests.

items.description: Verify actual Snake terminal input, pause, restart, resize, mute and clean exit.
items.verify: Real PTY with state assertions, Q and SIGINT exits, mode restoration and no surviving child group; retain Snake transcript.

items.description: Provide documented terminal launch and CLI options.
items.verify: Help works without a terminal; suite covers all CLI flags and nonterminal error.

items.description: Verify real macOS repeated sample playback and mute/resume.
items.verify: Existing native tests must advance playback and meter signal; fail on missing tests, non-macOS host, failed tests or skips. This does not establish listener-perceived quality.

argv: import os,sys,unittest; assert sys.platform == 'darwin', 'Native playback requires macOS'; os.environ['NEON_TETRIS_AUDIO_TESTS']='1'; suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests', pattern='test_native_audio.py'); assert suite.countTestCases() >= 2, 'Missing native audio tests'; result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite); sys.exit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun >= 2 and not result.skipped else 1)

items.description: Inspect Tetris/Snake style consistency and listen to reused sounds in actual play.
items.verify: Retain actual viewed captures at 80x30 and 100x35, color/monochrome, play/pause/game over. Record concrete observations and real listening observer/output device, repeated/rapid turns, food, collision, pause/restart, mute/unmute. Never attest unheard audio or invent user feedback; unresolved listening remains pending.

items.description: Document Snake launch/rules and retain an accurate fresh-session handoff.
items.verify: README/design reflect approved brief; sample credits are unchanged. Handoff names evidence, unresolved limits, fresh-file continuation and avoidable stops. A fresh build session can continue from the files without reconstructing chat; no status text is treated as approval.
